Title: Independent Store Provisioning & Identity
ObservableOutcome: Two trial stores can be provisioned with distinct store settings/branding and each operates under its own unique StoreSlug URL.
Preconditions: Platform Admin approves both stores; Currencies seeded.
AcceptanceExamples: Given two active stores with distinct slugs / When public catalog is requested for each / Then each returns only its own store name currency and catalog.
ChangeHistory: Original Phase 02 AC-01; onboarding/branding UI & write APIs pending

Title: Merchant Cross-Tenant Isolation
ObservableOutcome: A merchant owner cannot read or modify any record belonging to another store by altering a route or body identifier.
Rationale: Prevents IDOR and cross-tenant data breach.
Preconditions: Merchant authenticated in Store A; target record exists in Store B.
AcceptanceExamples: Given a merchant authorized only for Store A / When requesting or mutating a Store B resource / Then the server rejects the request with 403 or 404 without revealing Store B data.
TestReference: PLANNED-AC02-MerchantCrossStoreDenial (Public catalog read isolation verified in Products_ExcludeDraftArchivedInactiveCategoryAndOtherStoreProducts_AndReactivateCleanly)
EvidenceLocation: Evidence Not Available (Merchant Auth/Write Not Implemented)

Title: Customer Store-Scoped Registration & Shopping
ObservableOutcome: A customer can register within a specific store and browse/shop inside it without seeing products from any other store.
Rationale: Preserves single-store customer experience and email reuse across stores.
AcceptanceExamples: Given a customer registered in Store A / When browsing Store A or using the same email in Store B / Then Store A shows only Store A products and Store B treats the customer account independently.
TestReference: IdentitySpike & SessionTransportSpike PoC tests (90+4+49 PoC tests); PublicStoreCatalogIntegrationTests.Products_ExcludeDraftArchivedInactiveCategoryAndOtherStoreProducts_AndReactivateCleanly
EvidenceLocation: PoC Verified in experiments/ (04392c875c275e99f4b5ee378f63b3a8b8fc541d); Product Host Catalog Read Verified
ChangeHistory: Original Phase 02 AC-03; Auth not yet integrated into RetailFlow.Api

Title: Server-Authoritative COD Checkout
ObservableOutcome: A customer can complete Cash-on-Delivery checkout with server-recalculated product prices delivery fees and totals.
Rationale: Prevents client-side price tampering and ensures accurate order totals.
Preconditions: Authenticated customer with non-empty cart in Active store.
AcceptanceExamples: Given a cart with items and selected delivery zone or physical pickup / When checkout is submitted / Then the server reloads prices/fees and persists an Order snapshot with authoritative total.

Title: Concurrency-Safe Inventory Reservation
ObservableOutcome: Two concurrent checkout attempts for the last available unit result in at most one successful reservation and Available/OnHand/Reserved never become negative.
AcceptanceExamples: Given Available = 1 / When two checkout requests arrive concurrently for quantity 1 / Then one succeeds and one fails cleanly without negative stock.
EvidenceLocation: Evidence Not Available (Checkout Reservation Not Implemented)

Title: End-to-End Merchant Order Fulfillment
ObservableOutcome: A merchant can process a confirmed order through fulfillment until Delivered or PickedUp while enforcing valid state transitions.
Preconditions: Order exists in PendingConfirmation or Confirmed state.
AcceptanceExamples: Given a Confirmed order / When the merchant advances preparation and marks Delivered or PickedUp / Then OrderStatus and FulfillmentStatus update per allowed transitions and history is logged.

Title: Local Run Staging API Documentation & Baseline Tests
ObservableOutcome: The Product Host runs locally and in a staging/preview environment with documented API endpoints health probes and automated baseline tests.
Preconditions: SQL Server available; environment settings configured.
AcceptanceExamples: Given the Product Host in Development or Staging / When built and tested / Then all baseline tests pass /health/ready verifies SQL connectivity and OpenAPI/API docs match behavior.
ChangeHistory: Original Phase 02 AC-07 preserved; Staging Azure deploy pending

Title: Backup Restore Schema & Data Protection Key Recovery Readiness
ObservableOutcome: Database backup/restore EF Core schema recovery and shared Data Protection key recovery are verified before multi-instance production operation.
Rationale: Prevents permanent session invalidation and data loss across restarts or scaling.
Preconditions: Persistent Data Protection key ring and SQL backup policy defined.
AcceptanceExamples: Given a simulated instance restart or key-ring restore / When protected cookies or tokens are validated / Then existing valid payloads decrypt cleanly without breaking active sessions.
TestReference: PLANNED-AC08-BackupAndKeyRecovery (PoC key persistence verified in SessionTransportSpike)
